findings.evidence: The checks reject self-edges and unknown keys but never traverse the dependency graph. Two gates depending on each other pass check_semantics, despite section 2 explicitly forbidding cycles. Add cycle detection and a negative case covering a multi-gate cycle.
findings.title: Dependency validation does not detect cycles

findings.evidence: Progress validation checks only done <= total: {"done":0,"total":0,"unit":""} passes both shape and semantic checks, although the contract requires total between 1 and 100000 and unit length between 1 and 24. Gate title limits and the prohibition on control characters and line breaks are also unchec
findings.title: Several documented field limits are not checked
